title: program-local
description:
Superset of xdg-ninja's program schema for the LOCAL overlay
(config/xdg-audit/programs-local/). It accepts every upstream field plus
optional local-only fields (override provenance, per-file mechanism/env/
rewrite, and a top-level ignore list). `xdg-audit --submit` strips the
local-only fields so the submission validates against the pristine
json-schema/program.json.

An entry has `files` (paths that need handling or carry help), `ignore`
(paths deliberately left in place), or both.

Roles an overlay entry can play:
- override  : same `name` as an upstream program; corrects/annotates it.
              Carries `override-of` + `upstream-digest` so --update-db can
              flag it obsolete once upstream changes.
- addition  : a `name` upstream does not cover (e.g. grok, serena).
- ignore    : list a $HOME path in the top-level `ignore` array to suppress
              it from the audit report.
- wrap      : a file with `mechanism: wrap` + `rewrite` target, handled by a
              bin/<app> namespace bind-mount wrapper.

name.title: name
name.description: A program name (matches the upstream file basename when overriding).

override-of.title: override-of
override-of.description:
The upstream program name this entry overrides. Usually equal to
`name`. Presence marks the entry as an override rather than an addition.

upstream-digest.title: upstream-digest
upstream-digest.description:
sha256 hex of the upstream programs/<name>.json this override was made
against. --update-db compares it to the refreshed upstream file and, on a
mismatch, flags this override as possibly obsolete (offers removal).

ignore.title: ignore
ignore.description:
Paths deliberately left in place. xdg-audit does not report these $HOME
paths (a considered 'leave it alone'). Each is a $HOME path, e.g.
$HOME/.bashrc.

files.title: files
files.description: Files and folders that need handling or carry help.

path.title: path
path.description: A path to a file or a folder, e.g. $HOME/.grok.

movable.title: movable
movable.description:
Whether the file/folder is movable out of $HOME. Optional in the
overlay (required upstream); include it on additions meant for --submit.

help.title: help
help.description:
Markdown help for the user. Optional in the overlay (required
upstream); include it on additions meant for --submit.

mechanism.title: mechanism
mechanism.description:
How this path is handled. `env`/`alias`/`symlink`/`remove` are the
xdg-ninja-handleable set; `wrap` uses a bin/<app> namespace bind-mount
redirect. Absent = inferred by xdg-audit.

rewrite.title: rewrite
rewrite.description:
The redirect target path. Used as the bind-mount destination for `wrap`,
the link target for `symlink`, and — for `env` — as a fallback handled-
signal when the variable is not exported (e.g. HISTFILE): xdg-audit treats
the path as handled if this target exists. May use $XDG_* / $HOME
variables, e.g. $XDG_STATE_HOME/foo.

env.title: env
env.description:
For `mechanism: env`, the environment variable that performs the
redirect (e.g. DOCKER_CONFIG). xdg-audit reports the path as handled
when this variable is set, so a leftover $HOME copy reads as 'stray'
rather than 'unhandled'.
